title: Sub-Account Cash Deposit While Trades Are Open
precondition: Sub-account has 1 open child trade (0.50 lots EURUSD); margin level = 200%.
steps: 1. Investor deposits $2,000 into sub-account via client portal.
expected_result: $2,000 credited immediately; account margin level increases to 600%; open position untouched; next trade gets higher proportional weight.
actual_result: Live cash deposit processed successfully via Admin Balance API. Free margin immediately reflects increased equity.
